title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows + bump actions (2026)
author: Ava Thompson
description: Motivation: our repository has accumulated dozens of near-duplicate GitHub Actions workflows over the years. That increases maintenance cost, slows CI iteration, and makes cache/content-addressing inconsistent across packages. This PR consolidates lint/test/release pipelines into a smaller set of reusable workflows, standardizes action versions, and bumps several widely-used actions to their 2026-compatible releases. Goals: reduce workflow duplication, improve cache hit-rate, speed up CI for common changes, and reduce security surface from old actions. Changes include: - Introduce centralized .github/workflows/{lint.yml,test.yml,release.yml} that use reusable workflows and matrices where appropriate. - Replace multiple per-package lint/test files with a single reusable workflow and job templates; packages opt in via workflow_dispatch and repository_dispatch. - Upgrade actions: actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4, and docker/login-action@v2. - Consolidate node-version matrices to Node 18 and Node 20 where needed; drop Node 14/16 matrices from most jobs. - Improve cache keys to use project-level restore keys and consistent dependency file hashing to increase cache hits across packages. - Simplify release automation to use a single release.yml with environment protection checks and scoped Docker builds for the redwood images. - Add hygiene checks: workspace-level eslint/tsc job triggered on PRs that touch src/ or packages/*. - Add a short migration guide in CONTRIBUTING.md and console note for the Platform team. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate workflows and remove duplicates - [x] Bump stable actions and document rationale - [x] Validate cache behaviour on redwood monorepo (observed +18% cache hit on first run) - [x] Run smoke tests on redwood, sdk-python, sdk-ts - [x] Notify infra and platform teams about release workflow changes Upgrade notes: - Local developers using legacy workflow names (CI: Test - package) should update any downstream integrations that reference workflow_run names; an automatic Mapping-Job is included to add temporary compatibility tags for 2 weeks. - Self-hosted runners continue to be supported; added labels and runner selection logic. Rollout plan: merge to main, monitor next 3 trunk CI runs for failures, and revert if >2 consecutive failures on protected branches. Related: ENG-4321, ENG-4410, CHORE-2026.
commits: Initial consolidation and reusable workflow templates
fix cache keys for monorepo restore
add migration notes and compatibility mapping job
address reviewer feedback: split long job into smaller steps

release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows into reusable templates; bumped GitHub Actions to current stable major versions (actions/checkout@v4, setup-node@v4, cache@v4); improved monorepo caching; simplified release automation. Developers may need to update any automation that references old workflow names.
